title: Levi Simon's "Rock W U" is that exciting music that people love getting invested in
htmlContent:
Levi Simon's "Rock W U" is that exciting music that people love getting invested in. Music is entertainment and this record embodies that spirit, with each element making for a true experience of music that is fun to be apart of, as well as to show their must hear talent on this complete body of work.
